$comment: Crewflow AI model catalogue: FACTS ONLY (docs/ai/PHASE1_TWENTY_PLAN.md §3). Committed code, validated by a strict zod schema in catalog.ts at import; never downloaded or overridden at runtime. Security approval is NOT here: it is the TypeScript overlay AI_MODEL_APPROVALS in catalog.ts, a reviewed code change. Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens as published (standard tier); regionalUpliftPercent is charged on top by the budget meter (D14). cacheWrite null = the provider has no separate cache-write price. promptCache (Phase 7, zod enum) = the provider prompt-caching mode the gateway may request: anthropic-auto = one request-level ephemeral breakpoint with the provider default 5-minute lifetime (no other lifetime is priced, so none may be requested); openai-key = a hashed prompt_cache_key (inert until an OpenAI SDK is installed); none = never. Caching runs in development with synthetic data only until the release checklist records that zero-retention terms cover it.
